acceptance_criteria.description: The Products page is publicly accessible without login and displays the full product catalog under the heading 'All Products'.
kane_steps: Verify the page heading 'All Products' is visible
Confirm product tiles are listed without requiring authentication
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: Products page is publicly accessible and shows the catalog

acceptance_criteria.description: Users can add a product to the cart directly from the Products page using the Add to cart button, which shows an 'Added!' confirmation modal.
kane_steps: Click the 'Add to cart' button for the product Blue Top
Verify the modal text 'Added!' is visible
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: Add to cart button shows Added! confirmation modal

acceptance_criteria.description: Clicking 'View Product' on the Products page opens the product detail page, which includes a 'Write Your Review' section.
kane_steps: Click the 'View Product' link for Blue Top
Verify the section heading 'Write Your Review' is visible
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: View Product opens detail page with review section

acceptance_criteria.description: The shopping cart page is accessible at /view_cart and displays the heading 'Shopping Cart'.
kane_steps: Verify the page heading 'Shopping Cart' is visible

acceptance_criteria.description: The login page at /login displays a 'Login to your account' section for returning users.
kane_steps: Verify the section heading 'Login to your account' is visible
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: Login page shows Login to your account section
